info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Statement Files-spec
info.description: The Statement File Retrieval API enables users to access specific statement files associated with their bank accounts. By providing the account ID and statement ID, clients can efficiently retrieve digital statements in various formats. This API is ideal for banking applications, financial services, and personal finance management tools that require seamless access to user financial documents. Typical consumers include developers integrating Open Banking services and users looking to manage their financial records online.

get.summary: Retrieve the file for the specified account statement.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the file associated with a specific account statement for the provided account ID. It serves as an interface for accessing formatted statements in file format, facilitating user interactions and enabling seamless integration into financial applications.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the file associated with the statement for the specified account. This JSON object contains the necessary parameters to identify and access the statement file.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested file.

ListStatementFilesRequest.description: Represents a request body for getting statements for a specific account.
